chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام and said to him:
Can a man perform salat (prayer) while veiling his mouth? He said: "As for on a riding animal, then yes; and as for on the ground, then no."

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the ground, meaning prayer performed standing on land
key_terms.فَلَا: then no; indicating non-permissibility in this context
key_terms.مُتَلَثِّمٌ: covering the mouth or lower part of the face with a cloth

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while covering the mouth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on performing salat (prayer) while covering the mouth. It distinguishes between praying on a riding animal, where it is permitted, and praying on the ground, where it is not permitted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.782 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):

"Can a man pray while covering his mouth (muffling)?"
Imam (as) said: "While on an animal, yes; but on the ground, no”.
